sql:
SELECT
  metabolism.met_id,
  metabolism.met_conversion,
  metabolism.pathway_key,
  metabolism.enzyme_name,
  substrate.compound_name AS substrate_name,
  parent.compound_name AS parent_name,
  substrate_struct.canonical_smiles,
  parent_struct.canonical_smiles
FROM metabolism
JOIN compound_records substrate_record
  ON metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate_record.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary substrate
  ON substrate_record.molregno = substrate.molregno
JOIN compound_structures substrate_struct
  ON substrate.molregno = substrate_struct.molregno
JOIN compound_records parent_record
  ON metabolism.drug_record_id = parent_record.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary parent
  ON parent_record.molregno = parent.molregno
JOIN compound_structures parent_struct
  ON parent.molregno = parent_struct.molregno
WHERE metabolism.organism = 'Callithrix jacchus'
ORDER BY metabolism.met_id ASC
LIMIT 200;
